name: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
native_kbm_note: No source reports keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; shacknews and primagames list DualSense buttons only for PS5.
notes: PC and PS5 from shacknews (full table) and primagames, which agree. Force combos: LCTRL (Focus) = R1, so Ctrl+F / Ctrl+Space / Ctrl+left click produce R1+Triangle (Lift) / R1+Cross (Slam) / R1+Square (companion assist). Confuse is Ctrl+Z on PC; Z is mapped directly to R1+Circle. Slow (key 4) = L3+R3. Interact (E) and Target (middle mouse) both map to R3 on PS5. PS5 menu: primagames says Options, shacknews says right side of touchpad; Options is used here. Navigation contexts (swimming, ziplines) reuse buttons and are not listed. The second L2 'locked' basic action (PC E) is omitted because E already handles interact.
